Hab.3.2.bsb: O LORD, I have heard the report of You; I stand in awe, O LORD, of Your deeds. Revive them in these years; make them known in these years. In Your wrath, remember mercy!
Hab.3.2.kjv: O Lord, I have heard thy speech, and was afraid: O Lord, revive thy work in the midst of the years, in the midst of the years make known; in wrath remember mercy.

Hab.2.14.bsb: For the earth will be filled with the knowledge of the glory of the LORD as the waters cover the sea.
Hab.2.14.kjv: For the earth shall be filled with the knowledge of the glory of the Lord, as the waters cover the sea.

Hab.1.2.bsb: How long, O LORD, must I call for help but You do not hear, or cry out to You, “Violence!” but You do not save?
Hab.1.2.kjv: O Lord, how long shall I cry, and thou wilt not hear! even cry out unto thee of violence, and thou wilt not save!

Hab.3.16.bsb: I heard and trembled within; my lips quivered at the sound. Decay entered my bones; I trembled where I stood. Yet I must wait patiently for the day of distress to come upon the people who invade us.
Hab.3.16.kjv: When I heard, my belly trembled; my lips quivered at the voice: rottenness entered into my bones, and I trembled in myself, that I might rest in the day of trouble: when he cometh up unto the people, he will invade them with his troops.

Hab.2.2.bsb: Then the LORD answered me: “Write down this vision and clearly inscribe it on tablets, so that a herald may run with it.
Hab.2.2.kjv: And the Lord answered me, and said, Write the vision, and make it plain upon tables, that he may run that readeth it.

Hab.1.1.bsb: This is the burden that Habakkuk the prophet received in a vision:
Hab.1.1.kjv: The burden which Habakkuk the prophet did see.

Hab.1.13.bsb: Your eyes are too pure to look upon evil, and You cannot tolerate wrongdoing. So why do You tolerate the faithless? Why are You silent while the wicked swallow up those more righteous than themselves?
Hab.1.13.kjv: Thou art of purer eyes than to behold evil, and canst not look on iniquity: wherefore lookest thou upon them that deal treacherously, and holdest thy tongue when the wicked devoureth the man that is more righteous than he?

Hab.3.15.bsb: You trampled the sea with Your horses, churning the great waters.
Hab.3.15.kjv: Thou didst walk through the sea with thine horses, through the heap of great waters.

Hab.2.20.bsb: But the LORD is in His holy temple; let all the earth be silent before Him.
Hab.2.20.kjv: But the Lord is in his holy temple: let all the earth keep silence before him.

Hab.2.3.bsb: For the vision awaits an appointed time; it testifies of the end and does not lie. Though it lingers, wait for it, since it will surely come and will not delay.
Hab.2.3.kjv: For the vision is yet for an appointed time, but at the end it shall speak, and not lie: though it tarry, wait for it; because it will surely come, it will not tarry.

Hab.2.4.bsb: Look at the proud one; his soul is not upright—but the righteous will live by faith—
Hab.2.4.kjv: Behold, his soul which is lifted up is not upright in him: but the just shall live by his faith.

Hab.1.12.bsb: Are You not from everlasting, O LORD, my God, my Holy One? We will not die. O LORD, You have appointed them to execute judgment; O Rock, You have established them for correction.
Hab.1.12.kjv: Art thou not from everlasting, O Lord my God, mine Holy One? we shall not die. O Lord, thou hast ordained them for judgment; and, O mighty God, thou hast established them for correction.

Hab.3.17.bsb: Though the fig tree does not bud and no fruit is on the vines, though the olive crop fails and the fields produce no food, though the sheep are cut off from the fold and no cattle are in the stalls,
Hab.3.17.kjv: Although the fig tree shall not blossom, neither shall fruit be in the vines; the labour of the olive shall fail, and the fields shall yield no meat; the flock shall be cut off from the fold, and there shall be no herd in the stalls:

Hab.3.18.bsb: yet I will exult in the LORD; I will rejoice in the God of my salvation!
Hab.3.18.kjv: Yet I will rejoice in the Lord, I will joy in the God of my salvation.

Hab.3.19.bsb: GOD the Lord is my strength; He makes my feet like those of a deer; He makes me walk upon the heights! For the choirmaster. With stringed instruments.
Hab.3.19.kjv: The Lord God is my strength, and he will make my feet like hinds’ feet, and he will make me to walk upon mine high places. To the chief singer on my stringed instruments.

Hab.3.6.bsb: He stood and measured the earth; He looked and startled the nations; the ancient mountains crumbled; the perpetual hills collapsed. His ways are everlasting.
Hab.3.6.kjv: He stood, and measured the earth: he beheld, and drove asunder the nations; and the everlasting mountains were scattered, the perpetual hills did bow: his ways are everlasting.

Hab.3.4.bsb: His radiance was like the sunlight; rays flashed from His hand, where His power is hidden.
Hab.3.4.kjv: And his brightness was as the light; he had horns coming out of his hand: and there was the hiding of his power.

Hab.3.5.bsb: Plague went before Him, and fever followed in His steps.
Hab.3.5.kjv: Before him went the pestilence, and burning coals went forth at his feet.

Hab.1.3.bsb: Why do You make me see iniquity? Why do You tolerate wrongdoing? Destruction and violence are before me. Strife is ongoing, and conflict abounds.
Hab.1.3.kjv: Why dost thou shew me iniquity, and cause me to behold grievance? for spoiling and violence are before me: and there are that raise up strife and contention.

Hab.1.4.bsb: Therefore the law is paralyzed, and justice never goes forth. For the wicked hem in the righteous, so that justice is perverted.
Hab.1.4.kjv: Therefore the law is slacked, and judgment doth never go forth: for the wicked doth compass about the righteous; therefore wrong judgment proceedeth.

Hab.3.9.bsb: You brandished Your bow; You called for many arrows. Selah You split the earth with rivers.
Hab.3.9.kjv: Thy bow was made quite naked, according to the oaths of the tribes, even thy word. Selah. Thou didst cleave the earth with rivers.

Hab.3.10.bsb: The mountains saw You and quaked; torrents of water swept by. The deep roared with its voice and lifted its hands on high.
Hab.3.10.kjv: The mountains saw thee, and they trembled: the overflowing of the water passed by: the deep uttered his voice, and lifted up his hands on high.

Hab.3.11.bsb: Sun and moon stood still in their places at the flash of Your flying arrows, at the brightness of Your shining spear.
Hab.3.11.kjv: The sun and moon stood still in their habitation: at the light of thine arrows they went, and at the shining of thy glittering spear.

Hab.1.11.bsb: Then they sweep by like the wind and pass through. They are guilty; their own strength is their god.”
Hab.1.11.kjv: Then shall his mind change, and he shall pass over, and offend, imputing this his power unto his god.

Hab.1.14.bsb: You have made men like the fish of the sea, like creeping things that have no ruler.
Hab.1.14.kjv: And makest men as the fishes of the sea, as the creeping things, that have no ruler over them?

Hab.1.16.bsb: Therefore he sacrifices to his dragnet and burns incense to his fishing net, for by these things his portion is sumptuous and his food is rich.
Hab.1.16.kjv: Therefore they sacrifice unto their net, and burn incense unto their drag; because by them their portion is fat, and their meat plenteous.

Hab.2.18.bsb: What use is an idol, that a craftsman should carve it—or an image, a teacher of lies? For its maker trusts in his own creation; he makes idols that cannot speak.
Hab.2.18.kjv: What profiteth the graven image that the maker thereof hath graven it; the molten image, and a teacher of lies, that the maker of his work trusteth therein, to make dumb idols?

Hab.2.19.bsb: Woe to him who says to wood, ‘Awake!’ or to silent stone, ‘Arise!’ Can it give guidance? Behold, it is overlaid with gold and silver, yet there is no breath in it at all.”
Hab.2.19.kjv: Woe unto him that saith to the wood, Awake; to the dumb stone, Arise, it shall teach! Behold, it is laid over with gold and silver, and there is no breath at all in the midst of it.

Hab.1.6.bsb: For behold, I am raising up the Chaldeans—that ruthless and impetuous nation which marches through the breadth of the earth to seize dwellings not their own.
Hab.1.6.kjv: For, lo, I raise up the Chaldeans, that bitter and hasty nation, which shall march through the breadth of the land, to possess the dwellingplaces that are not theirs.

Hab.1.7.bsb: They are dreaded and feared; from themselves they derive justice and sovereignty.
Hab.1.7.kjv: They are terrible and dreadful: their judgment and their dignity shall proceed of themselves.

Hab.1.8.bsb: Their horses are swifter than leopards, fiercer than wolves of the night. Their horsemen charge ahead, and their cavalry comes from afar. They fly like a vulture, swooping down to devour.
Hab.1.8.kjv: Their horses also are swifter than the leopards, and are more fierce than the evening wolves: and their horsemen shall spread themselves, and their horsemen shall come from far; they shall fly as the eagle that hasteth to eat.

Hab.1.9.bsb: All of them come bent on violence; their hordes advance like the east wind; they gather prisoners like sand.
Hab.1.9.kjv: They shall come all for violence: their faces shall sup up as the east wind, and they shall gather the captivity as the sand.

Hab.1.10.bsb: They scoff at kings and make rulers an object of scorn. They laugh at every fortress and build up siege ramps to seize it.
Hab.1.10.kjv: And they shall scoff at the kings, and the princes shall be a scorn unto them: they shall deride every strong hold; for they shall heap dust, and take it.

Hab.3.1.bsb: This is a prayer of Habakkuk the prophet, according to Shigionoth:
Hab.3.1.kjv: A prayer of Habakkuk the prophet upon Shigionoth.

Hab.3.14.bsb: With his own spear You pierced his head, when his warriors stormed out to scatter us, gloating as though ready to secretly devour the weak.
Hab.3.14.kjv: Thou didst strike through with his staves the head of his villages: they came out as a whirlwind to scatter me: their rejoicing was as to devour the poor secretly.

Hab.1.5.bsb: “Look at the nations and observe—be utterly astounded! For I am doing a work in your days that you would never believe even if someone told you.
Hab.1.5.kjv: Behold ye among the heathen, and regard, and wonder marvellously: for I will work a work in your days, which ye will not believe, though it be told you.

Hab.2.11.bsb: For the stones will cry out from the wall, and the rafters will echo it from the woodwork.
Hab.2.11.kjv: For the stone shall cry out of the wall, and the beam out of the timber shall answer it.
